title: Steps to Pay new single Postpaid bill payment

steps.text: Login to the mobile application, Land on accounts dashboard (account landed in the debit account number)
Click on pay bill (postpaid) , Select New Biller
Select Biller details. , Enter reference number. , then  Click Next
Due payment amount will be auto retrieved.
If biller allows to pay partial amount, enter amount between minimum and maximum  and click on 'Pay'
Click confirm to receive OTP to submit payment.
